title: Custom Tile Tub and Shower Remodel in Cedar Hill
summary: Tub and shower renovation featuring large-format wall tile, a recessed niche, updated lighting and a refreshed enclosure area.
problem: The original fiberglass shower and enclosure looked dated and did not provide the custom tile finish or storage the homeowner wanted.
solution: Removed the existing enclosure, prepared the walls, installed large-format tile with a recessed niche and completed the surrounding bathroom finish work.
